scope: Editor candidate screening, not production acceptance or replacement of original gates
fullAndPhaseRule: Original gate success must not regress vs matched baseline; all per-seed/pooled results retained
noiseScreenLimit: Proxy screen only; original analytic/dynamic variance fixtures remain required
localHardRegressionRule: For every fixed point/channel: increase in absolute reference error beyond max(5e-6, reference*0.05, 2*combined empirical paired-seed/reference SE) is a hard regression. Empirical SE is a screening aid, not a formal confidence interval or threshold relaxation.
disposition: Reject if no meaningful local benefit, raw mismatch, full/phase regression, noise screen failure or local hard regression. Do not scan2/4. If useful, seek broader qualification before production.
